# Requirements

## Overview
Build a full-stack e-commerce store with Stripe payment integration, product listings, a shopping cart, and order management.

## Functional Requirements

### FR1 — Product Catalogue
- As a shopper, I can browse a paginated grid of products with name, price, and thumbnail.
- As an admin, I can create, update, and delete products.

### FR2 — Shopping Cart
- As a shopper, I can add/remove items from a persistent cart (stored in localStorage and synced to the database).
- Cart totals must recalculate in real-time when quantities change.

### FR3 — Stripe Checkout
- As a shopper, I can complete a purchase using Stripe Checkout (hosted).
- On payment success, the order status must be set to `PAID` and stock decremented.
- Stripe webhooks (`payment_intent.succeeded`) must confirm payment server-side.

### FR4 — Order History
- As a logged-in shopper, I can view past orders with items, totals, and status badges.

## Business Rules
- All prices stored as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point errors.
- Stock must be validated before creating a Stripe session (prevent overselling).
- JWT authentication required for cart sync and order endpoints.

## IBM Tool Bindings
- **IBM Cloud Code Engine** — hosts the FastAPI backend container.
- **IBM Cloud DB (PostgreSQL)** — isolated schema `app_feat_demo_8f92a` for products, orders, users.
- **IBM Secrets Manager** — stores `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` and `JWT_SECRET`.
- **IBM Watsonx QA** — ESLint + Pytest + secret scan before every deploy.

# Technical Design

## System Architecture
```
React (Vite) ──► FastAPI (IBM Code Engine)
                    │
                    ├── IBM Cloud DB (PostgreSQL)
                    │     schema: app_feat_demo_8f92a
                    │     tables: products, cart_items, orders, order_items, users
                    │
                    ├── Stripe API (Checkout + Webhooks)
                    └── IBM Secrets Manager (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, JWT_SECRET)
```

## Database Schema
| Table | Key Columns |
|---|---|
| `products` | id, name, description, price_cents, stock, image_url |
| `users` | id, email, hashed_password, created_at |
| `cart_items` | id, user_id, product_id, quantity |
| `orders` | id, user_id, status (PENDING/PAID/SHIPPED), total_cents, created_at |
| `order_items` | id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents |

## API Endpoints
| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/products` | Paginated product list |
| POST | `/products` | Admin: create product |
| POST | `/checkout/session` | Create Stripe Checkout session |
| POST | `/webhooks/stripe` | Stripe payment_intent webhook handler |
| GET | `/orders` | Authenticated user order history |

## Frontend Components
- `ProductGrid.tsx` — masonry grid with add-to-cart button
- `CartDrawer.tsx` — slide-over cart panel with quantity controls
- `CheckoutButton.tsx` — calls `/checkout/session`, redirects to Stripe
- `OrderHistory.tsx` — table of past orders with status badges

## IBM Tool Integration Points
- DB provisioned in `<200ms` by IBM Bob Subagent Alpha at project creation.
- `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` injected at runtime from IBM Secrets Manager (never in `.env` file).
- IBM Watsonx QA scans for exposed API keys before each deploy.
